problem: The core knowledge workflow and Hub import are implemented, and the token-mode K7a pilot passed on an isolated copy, but the umbrella still lacks a stage-by-stage K2–K6 acceptance record and a confirmed real-project cutover. Playbooks, instruction inspection and approved-rule composition remain unimplemented.

risk.rollback: Introduce the module without migrating existing projects automatically. If the local trial fails, disable its entry points while retaining its database and a verified export; keep the original repository-backed backlog available until an explicit cutover.

scope: Retain the delivered SQLite knowledge flow: project identity, threads/replies/tasks, revisions and retries, memory approval/search/context, attachments, controller backup, logical project transfer and resumable Hub import.
Reconcile K2–K6 criteria against existing implementations and main CI. Do not equate a merged slice or passing fixture with every migration acceptance criterion.
Update K7a pilot setup and live-client authentication for current token-mode defaults, then record an isolated import, real UI/two-agent workflow and restore trial against a fixed revision.

Cut over one explicitly selected project only after its import and recovery acceptance. Keep the repository-backed Hub authoritative until that decision; preserve rollback and avoid two writable sources.

After the core pilot, deliver K8 playbooks and report-only instruction inspection, then K9 preview/apply of approved scoped rules. Keep repository-owned documents authoritative unless explicitly transferred.
Keep hosted accounts, organization isolation, PostgreSQL migration, pricing and autonomous agent execution in their separate later work.
title: Finish knowledge pilot and cutover, then deliver playbook and instruction workflows
validation: A human and two agent sessions save a discussion, reply, find it, and create a linked task without starting or claiming a managed server.
Fixtures verify restart persistence, duplicate-request handling, conflicting edits, project access boundaries, superseded knowledge, and export provenance.
Removing a worktree or pruning runtime logs does not delete knowledge; explicit knowledge backup and restore preserve linked records.
Import fixtures preserve legacy IDs, source authorship labels, dates, relationships, and attachments; unsupported data is reported and repeated imports are safe.
Record actual owner workflow usefulness and retrieval effort before expanding scope or making efficiency or business claims.

Playbook checks advance with time and expose unavailable/stale evidence; instruction fixtures cover scope, provenance, dirty sources, approved-only generation, stale bases, and manual drift without implicit command execution or repository writes.
value: The owner can ask an agent to save a conversation outcome once and have humans and other models continue from the same durable context.
A reusable open-source module can later support optional managed hosting without giving the host control over customer development processes.
